pages.text: There are two main types of abilities, $(l:mechanics/abilities#passive_abilities)Passive Abilities$() and $(l:mechanics/abilities#active_abilities)Active Abilities$().

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: Passive Abilities are simply abilities that always provide some kind of effect, they never need to be activated or toggled. $(br2)If a passive ability comes from an Augment, that has a power draw, the passive ability may be disabled when running out of energy.

pages.title: Active Abilities
pages.text: Active Abilities are abilities that need to be toggled, for example through the $(l:mechanics/abilities#ability_wheel)Ability Wheel$(). Active abilities generally need to be added to the wheel by the $(l:mechanics/abilities#ability_wheel_editor)Ability Wheel Editor$(). $(br2)The power cost of an ability is how much power is drained the moment it is activated, whilst power drain is how much an ability requires every tick it's active.

pages.title: Ability Wheel
pages.text: The Ability Wheel can be opened with $(k:keys.synthetics.ability_wheel). $(br2)You can have multiple wheels, and each wheel contains a number of slots, each of which can contain a number of abilities. You can cycle between abilities in a slot with scroll wheel, and cycle between wheels with $(k:keys.synthetics.wheel.right_wheel) and $(k:keys.synthetics.wheel.left_wheel)

pages.title: Ability Wheel Editor
pages.text: The Ability Wheel Editor can be opened with $(k:keys.synthetics.ability_wheel_editor). On the left, is a list of available active abilities. You can select one to drag it onto a slot on a wheel, or onto the hotkeys on the right. $(br2)To add a new wheel, press $(k:keys.synthetics.wheel.add_wheel), to add a new slot press $(k:keys.synthetics.wheel.add_slot). You can use right-click to remove items from slots.
